articles.summary: On April 1, co-branded Prairie Fresh® Garozzo’s Italian Style Pork Sausage was featured on Fox 4’s Great Day KC as Michael Garozzo, co-owner of Garozzo’s Ristorante, prepared a comforting biscuits and gravy Easter brunch segment for FOX4 viewers.
